svg.title: Threshold sweep 20-45: routing quality and cost
svg.desc: Router accuracy, under- and over-routing rates, local share and estimated savings for thresholds 20 to 45 on 159 labelled prompts. Kept threshold 30; the automated rule picked 20.
svg.text: Threshold sweep: routing quality vs cost
159 labelled prompts, dry-run routing (no model called). Savings are estimates on input tokens.
